synopsis: In the aftermath of Silvermoon severing practical allegiance to Kael’thas, the kingdom confronts the strategic vacuum left behind: the Ghostlands remain hostile, the runestone boundary and Dead Scar remain under pressure, magical reserves are strained, and pride will not hold southern Eversong. The earlier joint destruction of an Amani-driven Scourge incursion inside Eversong showed that blood elves and Forsaken can keep one another alive in the field. Lethira uses her painful bond with Serenya Duskrunner to turn that local military precedent into a formal channel with Sylvanas’s people. A small Forsaken delegation enters Silvermoon under guard, provoking public revulsion and Liadrin’s anger, while Halduron’s casualty reports and Rommath’s assessment of dwindling reserves establish that no safer ally is near enough or willing enough to help. Serenya arranges a parley at Windrunner Spire, and Lor’themar leads a guarded delegation through the Ghostlands to meet Sylvanas amid the ruins of her ancestral home. The Banshee Queen offers to advocate for Silvermoon within the Horde, demands that Tranquillien be cleared and rebuilt as a jointly commanded blood elf–Forsaken base, and weighs the Blood Knights as part of the kingdom’s military value. Falanaras demonstrates powerful stolen Light under Liadrin’s command, and Sylvanas warns that the Horde will want to see whether that strength remains effective and disciplined against a skilled living opponent. Lor’themar preserves Quel’Thalas’s sovereignty over Tranquillien while accepting paired command, agreed force limits, shared supplies, and coordinated operations against the Scourge. Rumors of the negotiations ignite anti-Horde dissent in Silvermoon, and magisters answer it with magical coercion, showing Falanaras that the state is willing to manufacture public unity around an alliance many citizens reject. Lor’themar, Liadrin, and a Blood Knight honor guard prepare to carry the provisional agreement to Undercity, where the wider Horde will judge Silvermoon’s admission.
title: Chapter 16: Need of Monsters
